arguments.code:
gmail_password=None
for d in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
    if d['account_name']=='gmail':
        gmail_password=d['password']
        break
print('gmail_password_found', gmail_password is not None)
resp=apis.gmail.login(username='ka_ball@gmail.com', password=gmail_password)
print(resp)
gmail_token=resp.get('access_token')
print('token_set', bool(gmail_token))

unread_threads=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.gmail.show_inbox_threads(access_token=gmail_token, read=False, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    # page is expected list
    print('page_index', page_index, 'returned', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    unread_threads.extend(page)
    if len(page)<page_limit:
        break
    page_index+=1
print('total_unread_inbox_threads', len(unread_threads))
print('sample_ids', [t['email_thread_id'] for t in unread_threads[:10]])
unread_count=len(unread_threads)
